P1: 常青市 is a small, nature-loving city that is enveloped in green year-round. It is located between 2号道路 to the north, 1号道路 to the south, and 22号道路 to the west.
D1: From the sleeping man in the southwest (requires 居合斩 or 冲浪)
D2: Northeast of the Poké Mart, in the flowerbed next to the trees (hidden)
D4: From Gym Leader 青绿, after defeating him
P2: The Viridian Gym is located on a hill on the north side of town. The building is open, but no one is around. According to an elderly man outside the entrance, the Gym did not have a Gym Leader until recently, when a young man from 真新镇 took the role. He is often away, however, so challenging the Viridian Gym will need to wait.
P3: The Trainer House is located in the middle of the city. Built near 石英高原, the ultimate destination for Pokémon Trainers, the Trainer House allows participants to battle in a controlled environment. According to visitors inside the building, only the best Trainers gather here. These Trainers turn out to be real-life people met via the Pokéwalker, and will appear after the accessory is synced with the game. Up to 10 additional Trainers may be encountered this way. Any Pokémon in a Trainer's party above level 50 will have their level reduced to 50. Battles here give no experience or money, but the player will receive 1 BP for each victory. If the player has not used the Pokéwalker, the default opponent is Cal, whose team includes the final forms of each of Professor Elm's Pokémon.
P4: 1号道路 is a peaceful, country road that leads south from 常青市 to 真新镇.
D5: South of the northwestern-most ledge, on a tree (daily)
P5: 真新镇 is a rather small, sleepy town, located between the tall grasses of 1号道路 and the waters of 21号道路. Each of the two northern houses is home to a different former Champion of the Kanto region. Professor Oak's laboratory is located in the south.
D7: Oak's Lab; from Professor Oak, after earning all 16 Badges
D8: Oak's Lab; from Professor Oak, after showing him the 固拉多 and 盖欧卡 from the 埋藏之塔
P6: The northwest house belongs to 赤红 and his mother, but Red is currently away. He defeated his neighbor and rival, 青绿, to earn the Champion title, but gave up that role within the Pokémon League in order to continue his training. His mother is proud of him, but still worries that he is all alone somewhere.
P7: The northeast house belongs to 青绿 and his sister, Daisy, but Blue is away as well. She reveals that her brother serves as the 常青市 Gym Leader, and that his frequent traveling causes problems for the Gym's challengers.
P8: Speak to Daisy between 3:00 PM and 4:00 PM, and she offers to groom a single Pokémon. Grooming increases a Pokémon's friendship rating, and boosting this value is essential in order to obtain certain Pokémon. Daisy offers her grooming service once per day.
P9: The large building to the south is Professor Oak's laboratory. Speak with the professor to have him rate your Pokédex progress. He also asks that you visit again after earning all eight Kanto Gym Badges, as he will have a gift for you.
